assessments.reasoning: SPDX’s json/details/AFL-1.1.json gives licenseId AFL-1.1, name Academic Free License v1.1 and isDeprecatedLicenseId=false. Both crossRef and seeAlso identify the linux-mirror afl-1.1.txt and the 20021004124254 archive of OSI’s academic.php.

The SPDX repository’s unsigned annotated v3.29.0 tag object 76c9a79bb7d2bf851143b76b3935a4d7cbaa644b names a target of type commit, 31ba1a50e5397e00a304dbadc76531740e89ee48, matching the AFL-1.1 detail URL.
The raw archive replay preserves the cited origin and timestamp. The heading and application notice agree on v1.1 even though commentary after the license discusses v1.0.

challenge.method: Compared the tag object with its commit target, then checked the detail’s ID, title, deprecation flag, comments and both reference routes against the dated publisher capture.
challenge.results: The supersession comment coexists with isDeprecatedLicenseId=false. Both routes are marked non-live, and the archive URL is marked invalid in the generated metadata. The raw replay nevertheless identifies v1.1 at the cited timestamp. The later v1.2 replay of academic.php has a different timestamp.

limitations: The mirror and archive are publication routes for related material. Their repetition supplies no independent corroboration of legal-text equality, succession, compatibility, work-specific rights or board approval.
